description: Streams raw_games for a run via storage.read_raw_payloads and groups payloads per appid across sources into a RawBundle.
signature: def parse_raw_bundle(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str) -> RawBundle
docstring:
Load and group a run's raw payloads.

Args:
    conn: An open storage connection.
    run_id: The run to load.

Returns:
    A RawBundle with steamspy, appdetails and reviews dicts populated from storage.read_raw_payloads(conn, run_id, source=...) for the three relevant source values.

Raises:
    EnrichmentError: If run_id does not exist (storage.get_run returns None).
postconditions: Materializes the full bulk catalog (potentially ~150k entries) into memory as RawBundle.steamspy -- acceptable per design_notes since enrichment is a pure, offline, re-runnable transformation and this is the natural point where the whole candidate universe must be held at once for compute_developer_catalog_size's full-catalog lookup

edge_cases.input: run_id has zero raw_games rows for one or more sources (e.g. acquisition stage failed before fetching reviews)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the corresponding RawBundle dict is empty, not an error; downstream functions must tolerate missing reviews for some or all appids

edge_cases.input: run_id does not exist at all

unit_tests.name: test_parse_raw_bundle_from_fixture_db
unit_tests.description: A fixture database with rows for all three sources produces a fully populated RawBundle.
unit_tests.expected: RawBundle matching the fixture's row counts

unit_tests.name: test_parse_raw_bundle_missing_source_yields_empty_dict
unit_tests.description: A run with no steam_reviews rows produces RawBundle.reviews == {}.
